column1: # The user-facing surface B4 scans in the diff — must-match / must-not-match.
# S3.C.1 says a comparative claim "in the diff, PR body, docs, or benchmark output" must
# carry its comparator. Scanning EVERY changed path would red the very PR that adds this
# table, and would red a specification that quotes a banned ratio in order to ban it. The
# scope starts from the one check_no_claim_literals.sh already measured and defends —
# library and binary sources plus the book, never tests, benches, examples or fixtures,
# docs/**.md WAS IN THIS SCOPE AND WAS MEASURED OUT. Over the last 300 commits of
# origin/main the diff scan fires five times, on two commits, and three of the five QUOTE
# a fabricated claim in order to ban it — two of them in docs/benchmarking-gate-spec.md.
# Those three have no honest remedy: S3.C.1's exit is a comparator command, version and
# log, and there is no log for a number that was never measured. 2/5 is 40% measured
# precision against S7's >=90% admission bar, so the class may not block on that surface.
# The residual is recorded in the guard: a comparative claim added to docs/ prose is not
# blocked, and two real ones are named there.
# F6 -- book/** IS EXEMPT FROM THE RUST-LAYOUT EXCLUSIONS, and the rows below are the
# measurement that decided it. `*/examples/*` was written for a cargo target directory.
# The one directory it removed from the book is book/src/examples/ -- 153 of 441
# published pages, 34.7%, all in book/src/SUMMARY.md -- and that is where
# `851.8 tok/s = 2.93x Ollama` was published at da069a25f. B4 over that commit fired 0
# times as merged and 2 times with book/ exempted; 0 false positives over all 153 pages
# and over every added book/** line in 300 commits of origin/main.
# The exemption is scoped to book/ and nothing else. The pair
# is a single-variable control: same directory name, opposite verdict. If a future edit
# widens the exemption past the book, the second row goes RED.

column3: why

book/ at any depth

the spec that quotes "2.93x Ollama from a harness that never ran Ollama" in order to ban it — the exact false positive that removed docs/ from this scope
§0.1 of that spec QUOTES 36.9x over FasterTransformer in order to ban it; excluded by check_no_claim_literals.sh for the same reason

a bench states a bar
an example is not a published claim
a guard naming the literals it bans is not publishing them
evidence records what was measured, including the claims under audit
